visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a woman wearing a purple ribbed shirt from a back-view perspective; she turns her head over her left shoulder to face the camera, gesturing for silence with a finger to her lips and a playful smile showing braces. The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room with a green sofa and a wooden shelf holding a yellow Pikachu plush toy. (2) The scene transitions to a series of close-up screen captures of an iPhone interface where a finger navigates the 'Shortcuts' app. The sequence shows clicking the '+' button, selecting 'Control Item', adding 'Take Photo', toggling off 'Show Camera Preview', and adding 'Save to Photo Album' while renaming the shortcut. (3) The woman reappears in a medium shot, pointing her phone towards a friend sleeping on the green sofa covered by a yellow blanket. She taps the new shortcut on her screen to demonstrate its use. (4) After a visual flash, the screen suddenly turns to black and white with a large red '危' (Danger) character overlaying the center. The sleeping friend wakes up and stares at the camera while the first woman covers her mouth in a comedic state of shock. The video ends with a 'Mission FaiLed' graphic overlay.
